title: Chimera Finding Store implementation task graph

nodes.title: Finding types, fingerprint, and error classes
nodes.description:
Define the core data model types (ChimeraFinding, FindingLifecycleEvent, FindingStatus, ResolutionOutcome, FindingSeverity, FindingStoreEntry) and the fingerprint generation function.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- ChimeraFinding has all fields specified in the SDD data model (id, fingerprint, severity, source, location, title, description, suggestedFix, createdAt, status, resolution, originReport).
- FindingLifecycleEvent captures every transition with eventType, fromStatus, toStatus, actorId, actorKind, timestamp, and reason.
- Fingerprint = SHA256(file + ":" + line + ":" + normalizedTitle) with correct normalization (lowercase, strip trailing punctuation, collapse whitespace).
- Fingerprint produces consistent output for the same inputs across processes.
- FindingStatus enum matches the state machine: 'active' | 'triaged' | 'in_progress' | 'resolved' | 'ignored'.
- Error classes: FindingNotFoundError, InvalidTransitionError, FindingStoreLockError.
- All types are exported from the package barrel.

**Verification:**
- tsc --noEmit passes on @wrongstack/core.
- Focused tests for fingerprint generation with edge cases (null line, multi-line titles, unicode).

nodes.title: Finding store path, constants, and locking infrastructure
nodes.description:
Implement the store file path resolver, store constants (default retention TTLs, compaction interval, max findings per page), and the file-lock adapter.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Store path resolves to ~/.wrongstack/projects/<slug>/review-findings.jsonl, using the same projectDir resolution as the mailbox.
- Default retention: resolved findings = 30 days; ignored/wontfix = 14 days.
- File lock reuses the existing withFileLock() mechanism from @wrongstack/core/utils.
- All constants are exported from a single module.

**Verification:**
- tsc --noEmit passes.
- Path resolution tests use temp directories and verify correct file location.

nodes.title: Chimera report finding parser
nodes.description:
Implement the finding parser that extracts structured findings from the canonical Chimera review report format (### Severity (N) + numbered list items).

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Parser accepts a raw review text string and produces ChimeraFinding[].
- Extracts section headers by severity (### Critical, ### High, ### Medium, ### Low).
- Extracts numbered list items (1., 2., etc.) under each severity section.
- For each item, extracts: title (first line after the number), file:line from **File:** pattern or [BUG/SECURITY/PERF] prefix, description from paragraph text, suggestedFix from → lines or **Remediation:** sections.
- When (N) count in heading and actual item count disagree, item count wins.
- When a finding item has no parseable file:line, produces finding with location: null (not dropped).
- Empty/clean reports produce an empty array.

**Verification:**
- Run parser test suite with ≥90% line coverage on canonical report fixtures.
- tsc --noEmit passes.

nodes.title: Finding store: upsert, deduplication, and read operations
nodes.description:
Implement the core store: finding creation with fingerprint deduplication, get-by-id, get-by-fingerprint, and list with filters.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- upsert(newFindings) inserts new findings and returns { created, relinked, reopened }.
- A finding with a new fingerprint creates a new record with status='active' and a 'created' event.
- A finding with an existing active fingerprint produces a 'relinked' event on the existing record (not a new record).
- A finding with an existing resolved fingerprint produces a 'reopened' transition on the existing record.
- get(id) returns a single finding or null.
- list({ severities, statuses, file, limit }) returns filtered results sorted by severity (critical first) then by age (oldest first).
- list without filters returns all active findings.
- File filter uses substring match on normalized path.

**Verification:**
- Run store test suite with ≥85% coverage.
- tsc --noEmit passes.

nodes.title: Finding store: lifecycle transitions and compaction
nodes.description:
Implement the lifecycle state machine (found → triaged → in_progress → resolved) and compaction for old resolved/ignored findings.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- transition(findingId, to, actor) validates the transition against the state machine matrix.
- Valid transitions append a FindingLifecycleEvent and update the materialized status.
- Invalid transitions throw InvalidTransitionError with a specific message.
- Resolved transitions require an outcome (fixed | wontfix | duplicate | false_positive | stale | merged).
- getEvents(findingId) returns the full lifecycle history sorted by timestamp.
- compact({ maxAgeMs }) removes resolved findings older than maxAgeMs and ignored findings older than maxAgeMs/2.
- Compaction folds lifecycle events older than maxAgeMs into a single 'compacted' event on each retained finding.
- Compaction preserves all active/triaged/in_progress findings regardless of age.
- Compaction is idempotent — running it twice produces the same result.

**Verification:**
- Run lifecycle transition tests covering every valid and invalid transition.
- Run compaction tests with timing-sensitive assertions.
- tsc --noEmit passes.

nodes.title: Slash commands: /review findings and /review finding
nodes.description:
Implement the /review findings (list) and /review finding <id> (detail) slash commands.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- /review shows a summary: count by severity, count by status, oldest unresolved finding.
- /review findings --severity <sevs> --status <statuses> --file <pattern> lists matching findings with filter.
- /review finding <id> shows the full finding record: file:line, severity, title, description, suggested fix, status, and all lifecycle events with timestamps and actors.
- /review findings <id> is an alias for /review finding <id>.
- Results are formatted for CLI/TUI display (no Markdown rendering needed).
- Commands fail gracefully when the store file does not exist.

**Verification:**
- Run slash-command test suite with mock FindingStore.
- tsc --noEmit passes.

nodes.title: Auto-integration with chimera.review_complete and mailbox linkage
nodes.description:
Wire the finding store into the existing chimera.review_complete event handler. Add findingReportId to the mailbox message's taskContext.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- On chimera.review_complete, the finding parser is called on reviewText.
- The resulting findings are upserted into the finding store.
- The mailbox message's taskContext includes a findingReportId field.
- The finding store operation is non-blocking — mailbox delivery is not delayed.
- Errors from the finding store (malformed review, store unavailable) are logged but do not crash the event handler.

**Verification:**
- Integration test with a mock EventBus triggers chimera.review_complete and verifies store state.
- tsc --noEmit passes.

nodes.title: Independent Chimera Finding Store P0 acceptance gate
nodes.description:
Perform independent review after all P0 implementation tasks are complete.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- All P0 acceptance criteria in the SDD have linked passing evidence.
- Finding parser suite passes with ≥90% line coverage.
- Finding store suite passes with ≥85% line coverage.
- Slash command suite passes with coverage of list, detail, and error paths.
- Integration test triggers a mock chimera.review_complete and verifies findings are persisted.
- @wrongstack/core typecheck passes.
- Independent review finds no Critical/High issue.

**Verification:**
- Run all verification commands listed in the SDD.
- Attach command outputs and reviewer verdicts before marking complete.
